environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed on EKS 1.28 with PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The pod runs with a custom seccomp profile (doc-service-seccomp.json) that restricts openat/openat2 syscalls to paths matching the regex /data/documents/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+$ via SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ argument filtering. Additionally, the EFS Access Point is configured per-tenant with a root directory enforcement (each tenant pod mounts only its own subdirectory via EFS access point with POSIX UID/GID enforcement), meaning the mount at /data/documents inside the container physically maps to /tenant-{id}/ on the EFS filesystem with no parent traversal possible at the VFS layer. The RDS connection uses a separate PostgreSQL role (tenant_reader) that does NOT have BYPASSRLS, and the RLS policy on 'documents' table enforces current_setting('app.current_tenant') = tenant_id with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled on the role.

config.seccomp_profile: doc-service-seccomp.json with openat path argument filtering
config.efs_access_point: per-tenant access point with root_directory = /tenant-{id}, uid/gid enforcement
config.rds_role: tenant_reader (no BYPASSRLS), FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.k8s_security_context: runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 1000, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, seccompProfile: Localhost/doc-service-seccomp.json
